_comment: Hand-kept setup requirements table for TaxaWizard::workflow_check(). Source material: TaxaTools/vignettes/api-setup.Rmd, root README.md 'API Keys' and 'Troubleshooting' sections, TaxaWizard/R/zzz.R, grep -rn 'Sys.getenv' Taxa*/R. 'level' is 'missing' (blocks; default when omitted) or 'warn' (recommended, non-blocking). Groups (llm, gbif) are satisfied when ANY one member key is set; their own 'level' lives under 'groups', not on the individual key entries.

keys.purpose: LLM provider (any ONE of the LLM keys suffices). Anthropic/Claude is the ecosystem default provider.
keys.fix: usethis::edit_r_environ(); add a line ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-...; save; restart R

keys.purpose: LLM provider (any ONE of the LLM keys suffices). Free tier available.
keys.fix: usethis::edit_r_environ(); add a line GEMINI_API_KEY=...; save; restart R

keys.purpose: LLM provider (any ONE of the LLM keys suffices). Paid.
keys.fix: usethis::edit_r_environ(); add a line OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-...; save; restart R

keys.purpose: LLM provider (any ONE of the LLM keys suffices). DOI employees only; DOI network/VPN required.
keys.fix: usethis::edit_r_environ(); add a line AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY=...; save; restart R

keys.purpose: Raises the NCBI Entrez rate limit from 3/s to 10/s (ENTREZ_KEY, or its alias NCBI_API_KEY, either satisfies this). NCBI calls (fetch_ncbi_reference_sequences, audit_barcode_coverage, blast_sequences, verify_taxon_names backbone_id=4) work without it, just slower.
keys.fix: usethis::edit_r_environ(); add a line ENTREZ_KEY=...; save; restart R. Get one at https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/account/settings/

keys.purpose: GBIF download-API credentials (download_gbif_occurrences()). GBIF search (fetch_gbif_occurrences()) works without any credentials.
keys.fix: usethis::edit_r_environ(); add a line GBIF_USER=...; save; restart R. Register at https://www.gbif.org/user/profile
usethis::edit_r_environ(); add a line GBIF_PWD=...; save; restart R
usethis::edit_r_environ(); add a line GBIF_EMAIL=you@example.com; save; restart R

keys.purpose: iNaturalist computer-vision and range-check calls (check_inat_range(), score_image_inat(), generate_domestic_food_priors()'s iNat step, the optional iNat-range evidence sub-step of std_to_priors_kernel). Those specific calls hard-error without it, but each is an optional sub-step of its edge.
keys.fix: Register at https://www.inaturalist.org/ and create a JWT token, then usethis::edit_r_environ(); add INAT_API_TOKEN=...; restart R

keys.purpose: OpenAlex literature search (TaxaFetch::search_literature()). Works without a key at lower, polled rate limits; a key has been required since Feb 2026 per OpenAlex policy.
keys.fix: usethis::edit_r_environ(); add a line OPENALEX_API_KEY=...; save; restart R. Register at https://openalex.org/settings/api

keys.purpose: Xeno-canto v3 acoustic-coverage lookups inside TaxaLikely::audit_barcode_coverage(). Silently skipped (a warning() and NULL) when unset -- not a hard stop.
keys.fix: Register at https://xeno-canto.org/explore/api, then usethis::edit_r_environ(); add XC_API_KEY=...; restart R

keys.purpose: xAI/Grok via TaxaTools::register_provider() -- an example third-party OpenAI-compatible provider. Not part of the default provider auto-detection in zzz.R, so it never satisfies the key:llm group on its own.
keys.fix: usethis::edit_r_environ(); add a line XAI_API_KEY=...; save; restart R; then call TaxaTools::register_provider() with it

packages.purpose: Bioconductor. Required for TaxaLikely::build_sequence_matrix() (DECIPHER alignment of reference sequences).
Bioconductor. Required for TaxaLikely::build_sequence_matrix() (pairwise distance matrix from DNA alignment).
Optional. Only needed for TaxaMatch::blast_sequences(method = "local") / local BLAST screening; the default method = "remote" needs no local package or binary.
Optional. Only needed for TaxaWizard's Shiny chat interface and workflow_app()/"app" output; the console/CLI interface and script/methods outputs do not need it.

binaries.install: https://blast.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/doc/blast-help/downloadblastdata.html, or skip entirely by using TaxaMatch::blast_sequences(method = "remote") (the default -- no binary needed)
binaries.purpose: Local BLAST+ binary on PATH. Only needed for method = "local" in blast_sequences()/evaluate_reference_accessions(); the default remote method needs no binary.

network.purpose: NCBI Entrez/BLAST (TaxaLikely, TaxaMatch, TaxaTools verify_taxon_names backbone_id=4).
The currently configured LLM provider (getOption("TaxaID.provider")); url resolved at check time from the provider registry, so no fixed url is given here.

llm.purpose: Any one of the LLM provider keys (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY) satisfies this. Used by any TaxaTools::call_api()/llm_fn-accepting step.

gbif.purpose: GBIF_USER + GBIF_PWD + GBIF_EMAIL are only needed for the GBIF download API (download_gbif_occurrences()); the search API (fetch_gbif_occurrences()) needs no credentials, so this is recommended, not blocking.
